contents.name: Markov Property: examples include the finite property with positive witness C2 and negative witness Z
Theorem: if P is a Markov property of finitely presented groups, then P is not recursively recognisable
Corollary: the trivial and finite properties are not recursively recognisable
One also obtains as a corollary to Adian's theorem that the isomorphism problem is insoluble
